# Visualizing blackouts in Houston, Texas after the 2021 winter storms

## Load Libraries

```{r}
# Initialize libraries
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(stars)
```

## Load data
```{r}
# Load satelite data
data_dir <- here::here("data/VNP46A1/")


satellite_files <- list.files(data_dir,
                         pattern = "\\.TIF$",
                         full.names = TRUE,
                         ignore.case = TRUE) |>
  sort()

tile5_pre <- read_stars(satellite_files[1])
tile6_pre <- read_stars(satellite_files[2])
tile5_post <- read_stars(satellite_files[3])
tile6_post <- read_stars(satellite_files[4])

# Merge satellite images
pre_lights <- st_mosaic(tile5_pre, tile6_pre)
post_lights <- st_mosaic(tile5_post, tile6_post)

if(st_crs(pre_lights) != st_crs(post_lights)){
  warning("Coordinate refrence systems do not match. CRS transformed to match")
  post_lights <- st_set_crs(post_lights, "EPSG:4326")
  }
```

```{r}
# Load road data
roads <- st_read(here::here("data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"))

if(st_crs(pre_lights) != st_crs(roads)){
  warning("Coordinate refrence systems do not match. CRS transformed to match saelite data")
  roads <- st_set_crs(roads, "EPSG:4326")
  }
```

```{r}
# Load houses data
houses <- st_read(here::here("data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"))

if(st_crs(pre_lights) != st_crs(houses)){
  warning("Coordinate refrence systems do not match. CRS transformed to match saelite data")
  houses <- st_set_crs(houses, "EPSG:4326")
  }
```

## Create blackout mask

```{r}

plot(pre_lights)
plot(post_lights)
```
